svg.title: Lobster AI: inside the engine
svg.desc: Layers of the Lobster AI engine, top to bottom. Interfaces: terminal chat and query, MCP server, agent stdio. Supervisor (LangGraph): routes the request to specialist agents and asks the scientist keyed questions, recorded with who answered, human or model. Specialist agents from the installed packages, for example genomics, proteomics and transcriptomics, call scientific tools such as Scanpy, PyDESeq2 and Harmony. Data manager and provenance: AnnData modalities, tool steps recorded with their parameters, notebook export, replay --verify. Projects and catalog: local project settings (project.json, provider, model, experts) and an optional LaminDB catalog, off by default. Data access: adapters for AnnData/h5ad, 10x, CSV/TSV, VCF, PLINK, and MaxQuant and Spectronaut through the proteomics package; providers GEO, SRA, PubMed, MetaboLights.

g.text: the layers a request passes through
recorded with who answered: human or model
